create_OutOfGraphReplayMemory: create an OutOfGraphReplayMemory instance for storing DQN transitions with configurable replay capacity and n-step updates
create_WrappedReplayMemory: create a WrappedReplayMemory TensorFlow graph wrapper around OutOfGraphReplayMemory with staging-based prefetching
sample_transition_batch: sample a batch of transitions from replay memory including state, action, reward, next_state, and terminal flags with n-step discounting
save_replay_memory: save replay memory checkpoint to disk using gzipped numpy arrays with rotation of stale checkpoints
load_replay_memory: load replay memory state from gzipped numpy checkpoint files with validation that all expected files exist
